Name: Aegean Airlines
Company description: For more than 25 years, AEGEAN, a member of Star Alliance, constitutes Greece’s largest airline, providing full service, premium quality short and medium haul services. In 2013 AEGEAN united its strength with Olympic Air; in order to become even better and to offer a wide-ranging network within Greece, as well as abroad supporting Greek regions and ensuring the qualitative access even to the most remote Greek island. AEGEAN connects every corner of Greece with 180 destinations, in 49 countries with 307 routes and a total fleet of 76 aircraft, including the brand-new Airbus A320 and A321 neo, by the end of 2023. The new aircraft facilitate new services for passengers, as well as increased range capabilities, enabling expansion to new destinations and markets. As an outcome in 2023 AEGEAN transferred almost 15.5M passengers, 3.2 million more compared to 2022, an increase of 26%, reaching a new record high. AEGEAN has been announced as the Best Regional Airline in Europe for the 12th consecutive year and 13th time in the last 14 years. Moreover, AEGEAN was named 3rd Best Regional Airline in the World, was ranked 10th in Europe for its cabin crew, was amongst the World's Top 100 Airlines for 2021 (36th) and was amongst the winners of the COVID-19 Airline Excellence Award 2021 category, that rate the COVID-19 standards and best practices for the health and safety measures applied for both passengers and crew on board and on the ground. For more information, visit aegeanair.com.

Name: Aer Lingus
Company description: Aer Lingus is the national airline of Ireland, founded in 1936. It operates a modern aircraft fleet to destinations in the UK, Europe and North America.  Aer Lingus offers great choice, comfort and price, enabling customers to make smart choices based on their needs. It connects Europe and North America through its gateway hub at Dublin Airport, which along with Shannon Airport are the only European Airports with US Pre-Clearance.  It is Ireland’s only 4-star airline, as rated by Skytrax World Airline Awards for its consistent quality and excellence. It is a member of International Airlines Group(IAG), one of the world’s largest airline groups.

Name: Air Atlanta
Company description: The Air Atlanta brand consists of two sister airlines, “Air Atlanta Icelandic” with headquarters in Iceland and “Air Atlanta Europe” in Malta. Operating a fleet of B747-400 and B777s, Air Atlanta has over its 39 year history, proven itself as one of the leading ACMI & Charter service provider in the world.   Committed to providing our customers around the world with exceptional ACMI-, Charter- and Aircraft Management services, the two sister airlines complement each other and benefit from shared ownership and the support and know-how of their senior management - which never compromises on safety-, operational- and quality standards.

Name: Air Belgium
HQ Location: Belgium, Wallonia, Mont-saint-guibert Walloon Region, 2 Rue Emile Francqui, 1435
Company description: Air Belgium is a dynamic airline specializing in tailored ACMI/CMI (Wet Lease) and on-demand charter solutions for cargo clients. Committed to sustainability, the company actively participates in the EU Emissions Trading System to offset its carbon footprint, aiming for net-zero emissions by 2050. With a focus on reliability, safety, and customer satisfaction, Air Belgium serves a diverse clientele, including top freight customers, renowned forwarders, and manufacturers, ensuring high-quality service through a modern fleet and experienced aviation professionals. The airline's mission is to provide efficient and dependable services while fostering a culture of diversity and inclusivity within its team. By embracing ecological responsibility and prioritizing operational excellence, Air Belgium positions itself as a leading partner for airlines seeking additional capacity for their cargo operations.

Name: Air Corsica
Company description: Air Corsica is a regional airline dedicated to providing convenient air travel to and from the beautiful island of Corsica. With a mission to connect Corsica with the mainland and other European destinations, the airline aims to enhance accessibility for both residents and tourists. Air Corsica serves a diverse clientele, including leisure travelers seeking to explore the island's rich cultural heritage and natural beauty, as well as business travelers requiring efficient transport options. The airline partners with various local businesses, including car rental services, to offer comprehensive travel solutions. By focusing on customer service and operational excellence, Air Corsica strives to be the preferred choice for air travel in and out of Corsica, catering to a target market that values both convenience and the unique experiences the island has to offer.

Name: Air Dolomiti
Company description: Air Dolomiti is a regional airline based in Italy, operating as a subsidiary of Deutsche Lufthansa AG. The company specializes in providing air travel services to various European destinations, including major cities like Munich and Frankfurt. With a mission to deliver high-quality service and a commitment to environmental sustainability, Air Dolomiti aims to enhance the travel experience for both leisure and business travelers. The airline caters to a diverse clientele, including individual passengers and group travelers, while also partnering with travel agencies and corporate clients. Through its extensive network and tailored services, Air Dolomiti strives to meet the needs of its target market, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable journey for all its customers.

Name: Air France
Company description: Air France is a leading global airline that specializes in passenger and cargo transportation, connecting travelers to destinations across the globe with a strong emphasis on French culture and hospitality. The company's mission is to provide an exceptional travel experience, highlighted by its commitment to culinary excellence, as seen in its collaboration with renowned French chefs to create gourmet in-flight dining options. Air France aims to embody the essence of French gastronomy and elegance, offering a luxurious travel experience through its premium services, including the La Première suite. The airline serves a diverse clientele, including business and leisure travelers, and partners with various international airlines to enhance connectivity and service offerings. With a focus on sustainability and innovation, Air France targets a global market while promoting the rich heritage of France in every aspect of its operations.

Name: Air Malta
Company description: Air Malta ceased flight operations on March 30th, 2024. Since the first Boeing 720B touched down on Maltese soil on March 29th, 1974, ahead of our inaugural flight on 1st April 1974, until our final flight on March 30th, 2024, Air Malta has proudly represented Malta on the global stage.

Name: AirBaltic
HQ Location: Latvia, Marupes District, 3 Tehnikas Iela, lv-1053
Company description: airBaltic is a strong and internationally respected airline with the main hub in Riga and bases in Tallinn and Vilnius. We're connecting the Baltic States to 80 destinations across Europe, the Middle East, North Africa, and the Caucasus region, providing essential infrastructure and global connectivity for the region.    The airline was founded in 1995. The hybrid strategy integrates the best practices of both traditional network airlines and low-cost carriers. airBaltic stands out as one of Europe's most punctual airlines and currently operates one of the world's youngest fleet – Airbus A220-300 exclusively.   airBaltic's commitment to excellence is recognized by numerous prestigious awards, including being named the Best Airline in its region by Skytrax for three consecutive years.  In 2025, airBaltic made its debut in the global rankings compiled by Airline Ratings, which recognized it among the world’s 50 safest and overall best airlines, as well as one of the leading global airlines in sustainability and among the most preferred airlines in Europe and the UK.  The same year, APEX awarded the company the Five Star Major Airline Award for its commitment to providing a high-quality travel experience and before that – the Passenger Choice Award for Best Cabin Service in Europe.    With a workforce exceeding 2800 talented individuals representing over 30 nationalities, airBaltic is not only expanding but also fostering diversity within its ranks. airBaltic proudly holds a position among the TOP3 most desired employers in Latvia, a testament to our positive reputation within the industry.

Name: ASL Airlines France
Company description: Depuis 25 ans ASL Airlines France met ses « avions au service des hommes ». Elle se classe aux premiers rangs des compagnies aériennes françaises. ASL Airlines France est une compagnie aérienne française membre du groupe international ASL Aviation Holdings.  Elle est reconnue pour son très haut niveau de qualité de service. Des vols passagers pour tous Des vols touristiques : ASL Airlines France a développé, en France et en Europe, sa notoriété de compagnie aérienne passagers en effectuant des vols pour les principaux tours opérateurs français et européens. Des vols réguliers : En s’appuyant sur son savoir-faire inégalé en matière de vols passagers, ASL Airlines France a ouvert des lignes régulières au départ de la France vers l'Algérie et le Maroc et le Kosovo. Des vols à la demande : ASL Airlines France effectue des vols VIP, des vols incentive, des navettes d’entreprise et des vols à la demande. Grâce à la flexibilité de son organisation, ASL Airlines France peut proposer à ses clients des solutions adaptées au plus près de leurs besoins. La compagnie a ainsi équipé l’un de ses Boeing 737-700 d’une cabine VIP avec 56 sièges.  Des avions passagers dédiés : ASL Airlines France intervient pour le compte de compagnies aériennes européennes et internationales pour lesquelles elle met en place des avions dédiés. L’activité cargo  Du fret express : ASL Airlines France effectue des vols cargo réguliers pour les principaux expressistes internationaux et pour des opérateurs postaux. Des vols à la demande : L’offre de vols cargo à la demande répond à des demandes aussi diverses que le transport d’instruments d’orchestres, de poussins, de chevaux, de pièces pour l’industrie automobile ou encore pour l’industrie du BTP.

Name: Austrian Airlines
Company description: Austrian Airlines is the flag carrier of Austria, providing a comprehensive range of air travel services to both domestic and international destinations. The airline is committed to delivering a high-quality travel experience, focusing on convenience and efficiency, as demonstrated by its organized boarding process that prioritizes families, passengers with reduced mobility, and frequent flyers. Austrian Airlines aims to connect people and cultures while ensuring customer satisfaction through its attentive service and modern fleet. The airline primarily serves business and leisure travelers, partnering with various global airlines as a member of the Star Alliance network to enhance connectivity and offer a seamless travel experience. With a strong presence in Europe and beyond, Austrian Airlines targets a diverse clientele, including tourists, business professionals, and expatriates.

Name: BH Air Ltd.
HQ Location: Bulgaria, Sofia-capital, Sofia, 7a Dyakon Ignatii Str., 1000
Company description: Our History   We were in 2001 as a new Bulgarian Air company - BH Air.   BH Air is a private charter airline with a main base in Sofia. In the summer the company operates flights from Bourgas and Varna airports to the UK, Scandinavia, Italy and other European countries. Also, flights to Africa, Asia and the Middle East are operated for groups travelling in connection with cultural and sports events and on business. Furthermore, BH Air provides wet lease operations to several airlines. BH Air is structured around a team of dedicated professionals who are steadily building the company’s reputation of being totally committed to its customers and passengers, thus maintaining exclusive safety standards and outstanding customer service – Service Excellence. The airline currently employs a staff of 250 (herein 150 flight deck and cabin crew) committed to our vision to deliver sustained performance, service and growth.   Since its first flight in February 2002, BH Air has been focusing on the development of a genuine 21st-century air company that will have the power to redefine the aviation standards in Bulgaria. It has always been led by innovation and forward thinking and that is one of the secrets of BH Air’s amazing success story.   BH AIR provides its passengers with comfort, safety and remarkable service on board.

Name: Brussels Airlines
Company description: Brussels Airlines is a prominent airline based in Belgium, specializing in providing comfortable and affordable air travel to various destinations, particularly in the United States. The airline's mission is to ensure a pleasant flying experience for its passengers, offering a range of economy and business class fares that cater to individual needs and budgets. With a focus on customer satisfaction, Brussels Airlines provides amenities such as new Economy Class seats, a diverse menu curated by Belgian chefs, and a professional crew dedicated to making each flight enjoyable. The airline collaborates with partner airlines to expand its flight offerings, ensuring a wide selection of destinations for both leisure and business travelers. Targeting a diverse clientele, Brussels Airlines aims to connect travelers to major cities across the globe while promoting a unique piece of Belgian culture in the air.

Name: Bulgaria Air
Company description: Bulgaria Air is the National air carrier of Republic of Bulgaria based at Sofia Airport /SOF/. The airline also operates scheduled and charter flights from its secondary bases in Varna /VAR/ and Bourgas /BOJ/. We have a very well established route-network to over 30 destinations across Europe and Asia with convenient and cost effective transfer links to over 780 worldwide destinations in cooperation with our airline partners. We operate a modern fleet of Airbus A320 family and Embraer E-190 aircraft offering high level of comfort in both our Economy and Business Class cabins.

Name: Condor Flugdienst GmbH
HQ Location: Germany, Hesse, Neu Isenburg, 50 An Der Gehespitz, 63263
Company description: Condor - Passion is our Compass. As Germany's most popular leisure airline, Condor has been taking its guests to the world's most beautiful holiday destinations since 1956 – from 13 airports in Germany and Zurich as well as Basel in Switzerland to around 90 destinations all around the world. Condor operates a fleet of over 50 aircraft, which are maintained by the company's own maintenance operation, Condor Technik GmbH, according to the highest safety standards at the Frankfurt and Dusseldorf locations. In spring 2022, Germany's most popular leisure airline unveiled its new brand identity: Inspired by parasols, bath towels and beach chairs, Condor now wears stripes in five colors. This illustrates the development from a leisure airline to a unique and unmistakable vacation brand. The new design was unveiled with the first A330neo, which is operated by Condor since December 2022. As the German launch customer, Condor will then be flying 21 A330neo long-haul aircraft. Thanks to state-of-the-art technology and maximum efficiency, the latest-generation 2-liter aircraft is the European front-runner with 2.1 liters per passenger per 100 kilometers and maximum customer comfort. Condor will also receive 43 brand-new short- and medium-haul aircraft of the A32Xneo family from 2024.

Name: Corsair
Company description: Corsair is a prominent airline that has been providing exceptional travel experiences for over four decades. Committed to a mission of making every flight a personalized and human experience, Corsair emphasizes warm hospitality and attentive service, ensuring that every passenger feels valued and welcomed. The airline has modernized its fleet with next-generation aircraft, such as the Airbus A330neo, to enhance comfort and reduce its carbon footprint. Corsair caters to a diverse clientele, offering various travel classes, including Economy, Premium, and Business, each designed to meet different passenger needs. The company also engages in social responsibility initiatives, supporting sustainable tourism and economic development in the regions it serves. With a focus on reliability, comfort, and kindness, Corsair continues to earn recognition for its quality of service, including awards for being the Best Leisure Airline in France and having one of the youngest fleets in Europe.

Name: Croatia Airlines
HQ Location: Croatia, City Of Zagreb, Zagreb, 75b Bani, 10010
Company description: FULL COMPANY NAME: Croatia Airlines, the national air carrier, has been carrying passengers and cargo in domestic and international traffic for more than 30 years. We offer our passengers a high level of service, placing special emphasis on safety and service quality and promoting Croatian culture and tourism. Inflight service is constantly being improved and adjusted to the needs of passengers: well-trained and friendly flight attendants, comfortable seats, the inflight magazine and children's programme ... Croatia Airlines is a member of Star Alliance. Special attention is paid to aircraft maintenance, ensuring the highest safety standards.  At the moment we have 12 aircraft: 2 Airbus A 320 4 Airbus A 319 6 Dash 8-Q400

Name: Cyprus Airways
Company description: Cyprus Airways is based at Larnaca International Airport.  The company's mission is to build a strong and reliable airline, offering safe and enjoyable flights to and from Cyprus. The company’s long term goal is to contribute in the increase of tourism in Cyprus, while at the same time broadening the horizon for local travelers.

Name: DAT
Company description: Welcome to the DAT LinkedIn Account. In 1989 my wife Kirsten and I started a small airline focusing on freight transportation. Today, more than 30 years later, DAT is proud to transport close to one million passengers every year all across Europe with regional routes in Denmark, Norway, Italy and Germany. At DAT we live and breathe aviation with an utmost dedication to health and safety and customer service.  This page will specifically focus on introducing you to our charter service on our fleet of ATR and Airbus aircrafts. For information on our scheduled services I invite you to visit us on www.dat.dk. I hope to see you on board of one of our flights soon, Jesper Rungholm Captain/CEO www.dat.dk

Name: Deutsche Lufthansa AG
HQ Location: Germany, North Rhine-westphalia, Köln, 151-153 Venloer Str., 50672
Company description: The Lufthansa Group is a worldwide operating aviation corporation which includes more than 550 subsidiaries and investment companies. This is the official company page and career portal for the Lufthansa Group. Passenger transportation is the largest business segment of the Lufthansa Group and is carried out by the Lufthansa Passage, SWISS, Austrian Airlines, Eurowings and Brussels Airlines. The Group’s route network is operated through its international hubs in Frankfurt, Munich, Zurich, Vienna and Brussels. During the winter of 2017/2018 its flight plan comprised 288 destinations in 106 countries. The Logistics segment is also a market leader in international airfreight. As well as standard freight, its product portfolio covers express freight and special cargo. The MRO and Catering segments complete the Lufthansa Group’s product portfolio, offering the full spectrum of services for the airlines within the Group as well as for external clients. Lufthansa Technik is the global market leader in the maintenance, repair and overhaul of commercial aircraft. The Catering segment is also the global number one in its area. LSG Sky Chefs supplies national and international carriers with airline catering. In addition, it increasingly operates in adjacent markets. Another segment comprises the service and financial companies. AirPlus is one of the leading worldwide providers of solutions for business travel management. Lufthansa Industry Solutions is an IT service provider for process consulting and system integration. The company helps businesses worldwide in select industries with the digitization of business processes. Lufthansa Systems GmbH & Co. KG is one of the world’s leading airline IT providers. The company provides a comprehensive portfolio of consulting and IT services for the global aviation industry. More than 300 airline customers rely on the technological expertise and in-depth airline know-how of Lufthansa Systems. https://www.Be-Lufthansa.com/impressum

Name: Discover
HQ Location: Germany, Hesse, Frankfurt Am Main, 1 Hugo-eckener-ring, 60549
Company description: Eurowings Discover is the new leisure airline of the Lufthansa Group. Operating out of Frankfurt and Munich this carrier takes travelers to the world's most beautiful short, medium and long-haul destinations. A tailor-made onboard product with numerous extras and dedicated service make every flight a special experience. Travelers benefit from an end-to-end booking process and seamless transfers at the Frankfurt and Munich hubs as well as at many destinations of the Lufthansa Group and its partner airlines worldwide.

Name: Eurowings
Company description: Quality flights at reasonable prices. To over 130 destinations in Europe and worldwide. This is what the Eurowings brand stands for. Eurowings Aviation GmbH, based in Cologne, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Deutsche Lufthansa AG. Eurowings Aviation GmbH takes on the commercial management of the Eurowings brand and the flight operations involved, on behalf of Eurowings GmbH. In order to comply with this growth and meet the requirements of the new Eurowings Group, we are looking for motivated and qualified employees to join our team. We offer an exciting and diverse environment as well as the chance to begin a career in one of the most prestigious aviation companies. Let’s take off together! www.eurowings.com/karriere www.be-Lufthansa.com/eurowingsjobs

Name: Finnair
Company description: Founded in 1923, Finnair is one of the world’s oldest operating airlines. We are a network airline specialised in connecting Europe, North America and Asia via our transfer-friendly Helsinki hub – our purpose is to enrich life by bridging the world. Sustainability is at the core of our strategy. Our long-term target is carbon neutrality: we want to maintain the social and economic benefits enabled by air connections, while dramatically reducing the carbon footprint of air travel. For more information on Finnair, please refer to www.company.finnair.com or www.finnair.com.

Name: Fly Nordica
Company description: Nordica is an Estonian airline operating for other airlines, offering charter and PSO traffic. The company is a part of the Nordic Aviation Group, owned 100% by the Republic of Estonia.  The group operates long-term ACMI production for major airlines within Europe and utilizes two separate commercial operating brands: Nordica and Xfly. The group has bases in Tallinn (headquarter), Stockholm, Gällivare, Copenhagen, Aarhus, Vilnius, Lisbon, Hamburg, Munich and Turku. The group offers strategic partnership by providing long-term flight services to other European airlines with our aircraft and crews, thus releasing our customer's resources from the burden of complex in-house production. The group employs more than 600 aviation specialists across Europe.  The company plans to expand  in the coming years by constantly increasing its aircraft fleet. As a milestone of further expansion, the company introduced its first 180-seat Airbus 320 aircraft, and is welcoming other three Airbus A320NEO  in spring 2023 to start operating for a new customer.  The company embraces Nordic values and work culture. We value both, individual and team work.  For more information please visit our homepage www.nordica.ee . The company regularly recruits new aviation specialists in its growth. For open positions feel free to visit our career page jobs.nagroup.ee and join our growth team!

Name: French Bee
Company description: French bee is a modern airline that specializes in providing affordable long-haul flights, primarily connecting North America to popular destinations in France and beyond, including direct flights from Montreal to Paris. The company's mission is to offer low-cost travel options while ensuring a seamless and comfortable experience for its passengers. With a focus on reliability and convenience, French bee aims to simplify the travel process from booking to arrival, catering to a diverse clientele that includes leisure travelers, families, and business professionals. The airline partners with various travel service providers to enhance the travel experience, making it accessible for those seeking to explore the rich culture and history of France and other destinations. French bee's target market includes budget-conscious travelers looking for quality service without the premium price tag, making international travel more attainable for everyone.

Name: Iberia
Company description: Iberia is Spain's leading airline, renowned for its extensive domestic and international flight services. The company is committed to enhancing air travel through innovative solutions, including the integration of cloud technology and artificial intelligence to improve customer experience. With a mission to achieve annual profitability between 13.5% and 15% by 2030, Iberia is investing €6 billion in its strategic flight plan, which aims to adapt to evolving market demands and customer needs. The airline serves a diverse clientele, including business travelers and leisure passengers, and has established partnerships with various organizations, such as the National Transplant Organization, to facilitate critical services like organ transport. Iberia's target market encompasses both individual travelers and corporate clients, with tailored offerings like the Iberia Club loyalty program and specialized air shuttle services between major cities.

Name: Iberia Express
Company description: Iberia Express is a low-cost airline that operates as a subsidiary of Iberia, focusing on providing affordable air travel options primarily within Europe and to select destinations in North Africa. The company aims to deliver a seamless travel experience, emphasizing punctuality and customer satisfaction, as evidenced by its recognition as the most punctual low-cost airline for five consecutive years. Iberia Express caters to a diverse clientele, including leisure travelers and business professionals, and partners with various travel platforms to enhance its service offerings. The airline's mission is to make air travel accessible and enjoyable, while its vision includes leveraging digital transformation to improve customer engagement and streamline operations. With features like the Club Express Onboard, Iberia Express enhances the in-flight experience by providing entertainment options and exclusive discounts for its members.

Name: Icelandair
Company description: Icelandair is an international airline and the largest subsidiary of Icelandair Group, which in addition to its own route network handles flight operations for sister companies Loftleidir and Icelandair Cargo.  Icelandair offers an in-flight store, Saga Shop and operates the Icelandair Saga Club, expanding its relationship with customers. The Icelandair hub is located at Reykjavik/Keflavik International Airport in Iceland.

Name: ITA Airways
Company description: Hello! We’re the new Italian national airline, born 15th October 2021. We are a company belonging to the Ministry of Economy and Finance for the Air Transport Sector and partner of the Alleanza SkyTeam. We operate 52 aircrafts (7 wide-bodied and 45 narrow-bodied), but we have set a goal for 2025 to grow to 105, new generation Airbus aircrafts that are more efficient and green, with an overall reduction of 750,000 tonnes of CO2. Our loyalty program, Volare, collaborates with various commercial partners to be able to offer our clients plenty of opportunities to accumulate and use points. Ciao! Siamo la nuova compagnia di bandiera italiana, nata il 15 ottobre 2021. Siamo una società partecipata al 100% dal Ministero dell’Economia e delle Finanze per l’esercizio dell’attività nel settore del trasporto aereo, partner dell’Alleanza SkyTeam.  Operiamo con 52 aeromobili (7 wide body e 45 narrow body), ma il nostro obiettivo è arrivare, nel 2025, a una flotta di 105 aeromobili Airbus di nuova generazione, più efficienti e più green con una riduzione complessiva di 750.000 tonnellate di CO2. Il nostro programma di fidelizzazione Volare, attraverso partner commerciali, offre ai clienti ampie possibilità di accumulo e di spesa dei punti accumulati.

Name: KLM Cityhopper
Company description: KLM Cityhopper is a regional airline and a subsidiary of KLM Royal Dutch Airlines, specializing in short-haul flights across Europe. The company aims to enhance the travel experience by providing efficient and reliable air services, focusing on operational excellence and innovation in technology. KLM Cityhopper serves a diverse clientele, including business travelers and leisure passengers, and partners with various organizations to expand its network and improve service offerings. With a commitment to becoming the most data and technology-driven airline, KLM Cityhopper is dedicated to modernizing its operations and enhancing customer satisfaction through data-driven insights and agile methodologies. The airline's mission is to lead in quality and digital leadership within the aviation industry, ensuring a seamless travel experience for its customers.

Name: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines
Company description: Welcome to our LinkedIn page! KLM was founded in 1919 and is the oldest airline in the world. With a vast network of European and intercontinental destinations, KLM can offer direct flights to major cities and economic centres all over the world.  Through our LinkedIn account, we make sure you are kept up-to-date about KLM and other developments in the air transport industry.  For all COVID information, please see https://klmf.ly/COVID19. See all our community standards here: https://social.klm.com/standards

Name: LOT Polish Airlines
Company description: LOT Polish Airlines, established in 1929, is the flag carrier and largest airline in Poland, recognized as one of the oldest airlines in the world. The company operates a comprehensive network of domestic and international flights, connecting passengers to over 100 destinations across Europe, North America, and Asia. LOT's mission is to provide high-quality air travel services while ensuring safety, comfort, and customer satisfaction. The airline aims to be a leader in the Central and Eastern European aviation market, focusing on innovation and sustainability in its operations.  LOT caters to a diverse clientele, including business travelers, tourists, and families, as well as cargo services. The airline's partnerships with various global airlines, particularly as a member of the Star Alliance, enhance connectivity and travel options for its customers. With a commitment to excellence, LOT Polish Airlines continuously evolves to meet the changing needs of its passengers and the aviation industry.  The airline is dedicated to enhancing the travel experience through modern aircraft, in-flight entertainment, and exceptional service. Additionally, LOT is actively working on strategies to reduce its carbon footprint and promote sustainable aviation practices, reflecting its commitment to environmental responsibility. By promoting Polish culture and tourism globally, LOT Polish Airlines not only connects Poland with the world but also plays a vital role in the growth of the aviation sector in the region.

Name: Lufthansa
Company description: Lufthansa is one of the world's largest and most prestigious airlines. With hubs in Frankfurt and Munich, we currently fly to 211 destinations in 74 countries. As an industry innovator, we have long been committed to environmental care and sustainability, operating one of the most technologically-advanced and fuel-efficient fleets in the world. Our long-haul fleet includes the Boeing 747-8 and the Airbus A350-900, which are some of the most environmentally-friendly passenger aircraft in the aviation industry. Known for our premium services, we have recently been named “Europe’s best airline” by Skytrax and continue to build new or upgrade existing lounge facilities across our worldwide network. Our entire long-haul fleet features all new onboard products in each class– bringing us one step closer to becoming the first five-star airline in the Western Hemisphere. Additionally, the entire Lufthansa long-haul fleet is equipped with our onboard broadband wireless Internet service, FlyNet. For more information, reservations or customer service, visit lufthansa.com or follow us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and Snapchat. We look forward to welcoming you onboard. This LinkedIn page is maintained by Deutsche Lufthansa AG. We will not answer specific Customer Service queries here on LinkedIn. If you have an immediate concern or need to contact us please visit http://www.lufthansa.com/us/en/imprint

Name: Luxair
Company description: Luxair is the flag carrier airline of Luxembourg, established in 1962, and has been a cornerstone of the country's air transport services for over 60 years. The airline offers a comprehensive range of services, including passenger flights, holiday packages, and cargo transport, with a mission to connect Luxembourg to key destinations across Europe and beyond. Luxair prioritizes safety, punctuality, and customer satisfaction, ensuring that every travel experience is exceptional. Operating a modern fleet that includes Boeing and De Havilland aircraft, Luxair is committed to providing efficient and environmentally friendly travel options. The airline serves a diverse clientele, encompassing leisure travelers, business professionals, and families, and collaborates with various partners, such as German Airways, to enhance its service offerings. Luxair's vision emphasizes a commitment to safety, service excellence, and community engagement, reflecting its dedication to social responsibility. The company actively supports initiatives like Stand Speak Rise Up!, which advocates for victims of sexual violence in conflict zones, and partners with local artists and charities, such as the Think Pink organization for breast cancer awareness. With a focus on innovation and sustainability, Luxair continually adapts to the evolving aviation landscape while celebrating its Luxembourgish heritage. The airline aims to expand its network and improve its fleet, ensuring a bright future for both the company and its passengers. By fostering connections between people and cultures, Luxair not only enhances travel experiences but also contributes positively to the communities it serves.

Name: Nordic Regional Airlines Oy N°RRA
Company description: Nordic Regional Airlines, also known as NORRA, is a Finnish airline. The company’s core mission is to provide safe, high-quality regional flight operations for other airlines, agilely, ecologically and cost-effectively. NORRA is a preferred partner of Finnair and operates a significant part of Finnair’s domestic and European traffic. The company operates over 50 000 flights yearly. The company's modern and young fleet consists of 24 aircraft and the airline employs around 600 people in Finland. Norra's headquarters and operations centre are located in Helsinki-Vantaa and financial administration in Seinäjoki.  The company was originally founded in 1993 and has previously served as Finnish Commuter Airlines and Flybe Finland. For more information or to contact us, please go to www.flynorra.com.

Name: Norwegian
Company description: Norwegian Air Shuttle ASA, commonly known as Norwegian, is a prominent low-cost airline headquartered in Fornebu, Norway. The airline specializes in providing affordable air travel options across Europe and beyond, operating a modern fleet of 135 aircraft, including the latest Boeing 737 MAX 8. Norwegian's mission is to serve people the Norwegian way, with a vision to become the most loved and trusted airline in Europe, emphasizing customer satisfaction, operational performance, and sustainability. The airline caters to a diverse clientele, including leisure travelers, business professionals, and families, and has recently expanded its operations through the acquisition of Widerøe, enhancing its service offerings and route network. Norwegian is committed to sustainability, aiming for carbon neutrality by 2050 and actively investing in modern aircraft and biofuels to reduce emissions. The company has set ambitious targets, including a 45% reduction in carbon intensity by 2030 compared to 2010 levels, and is focused on integrating sustainable aviation fuels into its operations. Norwegian's loyalty program, Norwegian Reward, boasts over four million members, allowing customers to earn and redeem points for flights and services, further enhancing the travel experience. Reaching the Karman line (the boundary of space) is generally regarded as the first step to developing launch system technologies and serves as a good platform from which to understand the technical challenges involved in building orbital launchers, which is a field that is currently expanding exponentially. The primary goal of the project is to design, build, and launch a rocket to reach an altitude of 100 km. This project shall serve as a technology demonstrator and engineering exercise to enhance the quality of education at the University of Bremen through the availability of hands-on experience for the student body and inspire the student community. Name: OSCAR
Company description: We are an interdisciplinary team of students and researchers from UHasselt and imo-imomec. Our disciplines vary from engineering to computer sciences, from physics to biomedical sciences, and from bachelors to PhDs. We are developing the next generation of quantum magnetic field sensors based on NV centers in diamond for space applications. While advancing technology motivates us to push forward, our main focus is on personal growth and inspiring the next generations of scientists and engineers to join challenging fields of space and quantum research. This project series started in 2015 with a REXUS/BEXUS stratospheric balloon experiment - OSCAR-BEXUS - a first step taking NV based magnetometers out of the lab, for a viability study, followed by OSCAR-QLITE in 2017/2018. In 2020 OSCAR-QUBE was selected for the ESA Academy “Orbit Your Thesis!” program. That allowed us to test our sensor aboard the International Space Station (ISS) for a length of ten months.  Currently, we are developing the next iteration of our sensor OSCAR-QUBE+ to be tested during Ariane 6 maiden flight as a scientific payload for the ESA YPSat mission. On top of that, our OSCAR-PINQ project got selected for the ESA Academy Experiments - Space Rider programme. We gained a lot of experience from all these projects, while optimizing the NV-based quantum sensing technology. That is why we are working hard to further optimize our magnetometers and we are looking for next challenges to test our devices in the space environment.

Name: Iwiation
Company description: iwiation GmbH provides expert assessments in the area of accident reconstruction and visualisation.  Witness and video footage can be essential, if flight data is not available or radar data is not complete / insufficient accuracy due to terrain reflection.  The world-wide unique method called Immersive-Witness-Interview (iwi®) was developed to reconstruct missing data based on eyewitness statements and / or video information for flight path reconstruction. Flight path and aircraft attitude data can be reconstructed based on available witness / video information. The reconstructed accident scenario can become quickly complex and visualization can be essential to provide material for documentation, analysis and explanation, how the accident occurred. Further, more and more accidents are related to human factors. Therefore a photorealistic real-time visualization can support to better understand the reconstructed accident scenario from different perspectives. Root causes like weather conditions, mission, reaction time, diversion, etc. can be analyzed with the developed Virtual-Reality environment. To do so, the reconstructed flight path and the overall accident scenario including terrain, aircraft geometry and cockpit instrumentation are transferred into Virtual-Reality, providing a real-time and photorealistic rendering. This can be used by authorities during the analysis of the accident sequence and dedicated scenes can be documented in the final report. The integrated eyetracking technology allows detailed human factor analysis of accident sequence playback. The results can be used by operators for lessons learned training to further improve aviation safety.

Name: Mahepa
Company description: MAHEPA project is developing and flying two new hybrid-electric powertrains to enable cleaner, quieter and more efficient aircraft propulsion. By adopting a modular approach to propulsion system components design, for the first time two variants of a serial hybrid-electric powertrains will be tested in flight. The first uses a fuel-driven generator to charge the batteries and power the electric motor, while the second relies on fuel cells to produce power enabling zero-emission flight. Data from flight tests will be used to model future operating scenarios of hybrid electric aviation paving the way towards greener aircraft. The project is developing key technology and roadmap for market implementation of future hybrid-electric airplanes. After having completed successful ground demonstrations of a hybrid powertrain in previous project HYPSTAIR (FP7 605305), MAHEPA will deliver new, optimized propulsion components with increased reliability suitable for in-flight testing and future commercial deployment to small aircraft. The first flights of two four-seat airplanes equipped with MAHEPA hybrid electric powertrains are scheduled for 2020.

Company description: Somos una empresa ubicada en Burgos y que si bien inicialmente se dedicó a la soldadura láser, actualmente en vista del buen resultado de la tecnología láser y de la buena acogida entre nuestros clientes, ha ampliado los servicios a la limpieza y el grabado también por láser. Una de nuestras principales virtudes es que todas nuestras máquinas son portátiles, siendo capaces de atender a nuestros clientes en sus propias instalaciones, con lo que se evitan costes de traslado de moldes/utillajes y se reducen los tiempos de máquina parada.  La soldadura láser, aporta la distinción de que no se producen distorsiones térmicas ni mecánicas en los materiales procesados, no se varía la dureza, se puede soldar cualquier tipo de metal (Cu, Cu-Be, Aluminio, Titanio, Acero, Plata, etc…) además de que al tratarse de una soldadura más precisa se reducen las tareas posteriores de ajuste. Todo ello hace de la soldadura láser el método idóneo para reparaciones y/o modificaciones de molde y utillajes y eliminación de grabados. Todo ello partiendo del asesoramiento técnico y la profesionalidad de técnicos cualificados y con amplia experiencia en el sector. El grabado-marcado láser  nos permite insertar cualquier referencia, logotipo, fechador, etc… en los moldes o el utillaje de una determinada empresa, a partir de un diseño entregado por el propio cliente o a partir de diseños creados por nosotros mismos.  En cuanto a la limpieza láser, se trata de un proceso en el que se vaporiza la suciedad, no existiendo contacto físico con el material a limpiar, y con el que se evita el uso de productos químicos, la generación de residuos, y el empleo de medios mecánicos de limpieza que implican la aparición de marcas y con el tiempo variaciones dimensionales.   Toda nuestra experiencia y buen hacer, nos ha llevado a que importantes empresas españolas hayan confiado en nosotros y nuestras maquinas láser para desarrollar trabajos en empresas del mismo grupo en el extranjero.

Name: ClimOP
Company description: The overall impact of aviation emissions on climate (CO2 and other emissions) has been estimated to be 5% of the total anthropogenic radiative forcing. Although in recent years the aviation sector has put significant efforts in stabilising its CO2 emissions at 2020 levels through a combination of technological innovations and regulation, a lot remains to be done to reduce the overall impact of aviation on climate.  ClimOp aims to investigate, in a sound research framework, which operational improvements may have a positive impact on climate, taking non-CO2 effects from NOx, water vapour and contrails, into account.  As a first step, ClimOP will identify a set of operational improvements that are potentially effective in reducing the impact of aviation on climate. A preliminary list of promising improvements includes, for example, electric taxiing, flexible runway usage and intelligent runways lights, flexible terminal-manoeuvring-area operations and intermediate stops. ClimOp will quantify the impact these measures have on climate.  Subsequently, the feasibility, effectiveness, and impact on aviation stakeholders of the proposed operational improvements will be validated with representatives of all actors in the aviation industry, such as airlines, airports, passengers and ANSPs. The validation will also account for economic factors and the constraints posed by safety and security requirements.  Finally, harmonised mitigation strategies will be provided, together with a series of recommendations for policymakers, to support measures to implement the proposed set of operational improvements.

We want to make life easier, take away the hassle and make people happy. By taking away the hassle to figure out how to cover the first and last mile when flying continental, and provide our costumer with a door- to-door solution requiring only one purchase, we can make travel a lot more comfortable.

Name: Vintage Flights
Company description: Take a flight INTO HISTORY The Mustang is probably the most recognized fighter of World War II. Its speed and range made it the ideal bomber escort. Our Mustang was built in 1944. It served with the 434th Fighter Squadron, 479th Fighter Group as “SCAT VII” L2-W. It was the personal plane of Major Robin Olds, a triple ace who scored his 4 last kills in this particular machine. It is one of those rare P-51 Mustangs who survived WWII and is now still flying in the same color scheme it had over 70 years ago. Experience the Mustang P-51 yourself with our special Hero-package for €2.200 all-in, contact us for a personalised offer.  Great news: We have recently established a partnership with the Antwerp-based Stampe & Vertongen museum to support them and keep its vintage aircraft in the air. One of these iconic aircraft is the ex-Belgian Air Force Fouga Magister CM.170 "MT-5". The twin-engine jet trainer joined the Belgian Air Force in 1960 and was once part of the famous display team 'Red Devils', of which it is now the only one retaining its original color scheme. After retirement from the Air Force, "MT-5" was shipped to Israel and later flew in the USA for a private owner. In 2014, "MT-5" arrived back at its new home base in Antwerp. The aircraft received major restoration and could finally return to the Belgian skies in 2017, where it belongs. In order to keep the Fouga in the air, you can sponsor the Fouga Project by donating €2.000 or more to the S&V museum. In return for your generous gift, one of our Fouga pilots will give you a unique hands-on experience. For more information about becoming a sponsor, please contact us on https://vintage.flights/contact/.
